extras.real_size: shield wall set: four painted round shields (84 cm diameter) leaning on a wooden rack, 3.35 m wide, 0.93 m high
extras.notes: four round shields in a slightly overlapping row on a walnut rack (ground sill with brass stop strip, leaning beam, three posts with feet, braces and brass caps); each shield has a domed painted face, six honey wood back planks with a batten, brass or leather rim and a steel boss on a riveted brass flange; motifs: blue/cream halves, brass spiral on red, cream/blue rings, brass star on ash wood (no crests, crosses or national symbols); front faces -Y; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
